reason: I like the idea of an agent doing the boring rebalancing, but I'm not handing real money to a cartoon pet from an app with no broker partner yet and no price. Robinhood and Public already cost me nothing, and I enjoy making my own trades.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels like a game, not something I'd trust with my actual portfolio, and "licensed broker partner, planned later" with an unset price is a lot of maybes for me to sign up to pay for.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker actually holding the money with SIPC coverage, plus a few months of the demo agent visibly beating or matching my own index buys after fees.
